statement_summary: Security Officer designated in writing and named to clients
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; no client or plant risk above Low accepted
Sanctions; good-faith reporting protected
Supplier security terms; annual MSP and SaaS reviews
Annual independent evaluation
Records kept at least 3 years or longer by contract
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts only, including the MSP
Least privilege; separate administrator accounts
Client security information only in restricted folders for client-approved staff; client approval list
Departure checklist; clients and plants told within 2 working days
Monthly account and folder reconciliation
MFA everywhere including MSP-held administrator logins
Named vendor accounts with MFA; no always-on remote access or inbound vendor rules
Unique 12-character passwords in the password manager; yearly Wi-Fi change
Open only the client information your engagement needs
No practice or client information in personal accounts or public AI tools
Company encrypted USB drives only; scan before site trips; never connect to client networks
Lock screens; never share credentials; never approve an unexpected MFA prompt
Training at hire and yearly; phishing exercises; client-information module
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Runbook and contact card with client security contacts kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Client clocks start at discovery: reactor plant within 4 hours; Part 37 client within 24 hours
Florida breach decision with counsel; deadlines from the P08 matrix
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under contract
Ransom payment only with approvals and OFAC check
Suspected Safeguards Information received: stop, isolate, call the plant
Vendor incident reports logged and handled
Annual tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Four levels including Client Security-Related
Encrypt Client Security-Related and Restricted data at rest and in transit
Client security information only in restricted folders under SEC-INFO-01; never copy background records; never accept SGI
Inventory of computers, USB drives, SaaS, and sensitive data locations
New tools approved before receiving Confidential or higher data
Approved AI tools only; suite AI assistant off; never Client Security-Related data in AI
90-day immutable backups; quarterly restore; monthly SYS-02 export; monthly lab image
Wipe or certified destruction with records; drives wiped after each outage
Return or destroy client security information at engagement close-out; remove unneeded personal data
